Diego M: morning team! first-week setup question — I need to install Homebrew, Rosetta, and a USB kernel extension for a small logic analyzer to do hw debugging. My laptop is non-admin. what's the approved flow for getting temporary admin?
Aria (IT): welcome Diego! we avoid persistent admin for new hires. We offer two options: (1) grant ephemeral admin for a limited window via our admin-approval workflow, or (2) IT can push the required packages via MDM if they are in our approved bundle. Which route do you prefer?
Diego M: I'd prefer ephemeral admin so I can `brew install` and run a few `cargo` builds. The USB device needs `kext`/system extension, it's from TotalPhase.
Ben (Eng): FYI for the logic analyzer you might be able to use the vendor's user-space driver (libusb) instead of a kext. If not, we'll need a signed package.
Liam (Security): quick note — Security prohibits users from disabling SIP or approving unsigned kexts. If a kernel extension is required it must be notarized and distributed via the MDM catalog. Ephemeral admin is ok for installing user-level tools, not for installing kexts that modify kernel space.
Diego M: understood. I only asked because the build needs `brew` and `rustup` and then the vendor tool complains without the kext.
Aria (IT): procedure: 1) confirm which binaries you need and link to vendor pkg/urls in the ticket, 2) IT will evaluate and either push signed pkg via MDM or grant a one-hour admin token. We'll prefer pushing via MDM for anything that touches kernel or system extensions.
Diego M: linking the vendor download now: https://totalphase.com/downloads/logic-analyzer-mac.tar.gz and the build steps: `brew install libusb`, `brew install rustup`, `cargo install tl-ctl`.
IT Helpdesk: created ticket #INC-93210 and assigned to Aria (IT) and MDM team. Please attach the vendor license and checksum if available. :ticket:
mdm-bot: queued review: vendor package requires signature check. Actions available: `push-approved-pkg`, `grant-ephemeral-admin`, `request-notarization`.
Aria (IT): I ran a quick checksum against the download and the vendor provides a signed installer? can you DM the MD5/SHA and the vendor name for procurement?
Diego M: DM'd the checksum and vendor invoice. Also, is there a shortcut to run `brew` without admin? I think corebrew uses `/opt/homebrew` on Apple silicon and often doesn't need admin for install, but some formulae symlink to `/usr/local` and require perms.
Ben (Eng): on M1/M2 default `/opt/homebrew` is fine. You can install to your user prefix if needed: `mkdir -p $HOME/.homebrew && git clone https://github.com/Homebrew/brew $HOME/.homebrew && $HOME/.homebrew/bin/brew install libusb` — no admin needed. That might unblock you while IT processes the kext.
Diego M: nice, trying that now... it started downloading. Thanks Ben.
Aria (IT): good progress. Security still needs to review the kext; if it's unavoidable we'll request the vendor to notarize and sign the kernel extension and then we'll push via MDM. In parallel, do you want the ephemeral admin token for anything else?
Diego M: just for rustup and cargo installs that might need to write to `/usr/local` later. But if the user-local brew works I'm fine waiting on the kext.
Liam (Security): approving ephemeral admin for user installations only. Aria, you can grant a 60-minute admin token scoped to Diego's device serial. Audit log will record sudo and installs. No elevated permissions for kernel or SIP changes.
mdm-bot: action taken: `grant-ephemeral-admin` -> Token issued for device serial REDACTED, duration 60 minutes. Audit link: https://internal.logs/admintokens/93210
Diego M: I got a popup "Temporary Admin Access Granted" and was prompted to authenticate. Doing `rustup` and `cargo` now.
Diego M: everything installed. The vendor app still warns about missing system extension but runs with limited features. I'll file an eng request to see if we can avoid kernel-level dependency.
Ben (Eng): if you paste the vendor error we can try the user-space fallback. Most of our CI builds don't require kexts.
Diego M: error snippet: "driver not loaded: com.totalphase.logic.kext — falling back to USB passthrough (limited)"
Aria (IT): thanks. We'll close the ticket once Security confirms the vendor will notarize if kernel access is required. Diego, please revoke the token when done or it will auto-expire.
IT Helpdesk: closing task for temporary admin issuance. Ticket #INC-93210 marked `in progress` for vendor notarization follow-up. Reopen if you need additional access. :white_check_mark:
